text:
zoe: Heads-up — we have a reproducible duplicate-callback issue in the webhook sample when receivers return 429 with certain Retry-After values. Small surface (~0.4% in staging) but noisy enough to worry.
ci-bot: deploy: ruby-sdk@1.8.2 promoted to staging (2026-05-10T14:13:09Z) :rocket:
ben: Can you paste a sanitized trace? I want to confirm whether Retry-After is numeric, RFC1123 (IMF-fixdate), or an obs-date. Different SDKs handled those differently.
zoe: Pasted minimal trace: 
```
POST /callbacks -> 429
Header: Retry-After: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:16:00 GMT
Client retried immediately -> 200 (duplicate delivered)
```
akira: Two likely culprits: 1) SDKs parsing only delta-seconds and throwing on date formats, falling back to immediate retry. 2) Clock skew + negative-jitter bug where waiting calculation ends up <= 0 and short-circuits. I saw both in past incidents.
mercy: Also noticed the sample-apps don't set any idempotency token on outgoing callbacks. Receivers are expected to dedupe, which is a fragile assumption. We should ship a default lightweight idempotency header.
ben: Proposal: (A) Parity fix: every SDK must parse Retry-After supporting delta-seconds, IMF-fixdate (RFC7231), and common obs-date fallbacks. (B) Safety: if parsed date <= now (due to clock skew), treat as small positive wait (e.g., min_wait = 1s) instead of zero. (C) Jitter: make it strictly non-negative and additive: wait += uniform(0, jitter_ms). (D) Idempotency: attach X-Redwood-Idempotency: uuid4 on outgoing webhooks by default; samples can opt-out. (E) Telemetry: emit webhook_duplicate_detected with webhook_id + sample_app label to monitor.
azira: For parsing subtleties: some servers send obs-date like "Sunday, 10-May-2026 14:16:00 GMT" or other legacy forms. We should include a small lenient parser in the SDKs (try parse_date RFC1123, then rfc850, then asctime), falling back to delta-seconds. Document the exact precedence.
akira: Quick Ruby PoC: 
```ruby
ra = resp.get_header('retry-after')
wait = nil
if ra =~ /^[0-9]+$/
  wait = ra.to_i
else
  begin
    wait = Time.httpdate(ra) - Time.now
  rescue ArgumentError
    begin
      wait = Time.rfc2822(ra) - Time.now # lenient fallback
    rescue ArgumentError
      wait = nil
    end
  end
end
wait = [wait || default_backoff, 1].max + rand(0..jitter_ms)/1000.0
sleep(wait)
```
ben: For go/c/py we should implement similar fallback chain; unit test matrix should include numeric, IMF-fixdate, rfc850, asctime formats, and an expired date case.
zoe: On idempotency semantics: recommend header name X-Redwood-Idempotency, key = uuid4, and a server-side dedupe window of 60s by default. We'll document TTL expectations so receivers know how long to keep keys. The SDK helper should allow callers to provide their own key or let SDK generate one per outgoing webhook call.
akira: One odd edge we found: some receivers validate HMAC signatures derived from payload + timestamp. If SDK replays with a different timestamp header, receiver may accept both as valid and still dedupe incorrectly. We should standardize how sample-apps sign payloads (use the same timestamp value and include idempotency key in signature). Update samples accordingly.
ben: CI changes: add a sample lint rule that fails builds if sample webhook senders don't either attach X-Redwood-Idempotency or set explicit opt-out in config. Add an integration e2e job samples/webhook-replay that spins a fake receiver returning 429 with both numeric and date Retry-After, and asserts client waits and only one payload is accepted if the receiver dedupes.
emerald: Telemetry/alerts: emit webhook_duplicate_detected and correlate by sample_app and endpoint. Create a small staging dashboard and alert if duplicate rate > 0.2% prod or >0.05% staging. Also add a migration blurb for customers with self-hosted SDKs.
zoe: Feature flags: add runtime flags honor_retry_after (default true) and attach_idempotency_header (default true) so we can fast-toggle behavior if we detect regressions.
akira: Implementation details: 1) parser returns duration; if duration <= 0 then set to min_wait_seconds. 2) jitter = rand(0..jitter_ms) non-negative. 3) cap wait to max_backoff_seconds. 4) Make sure Date parsing normalizes to UTC (avoid local time issues). 5) Include unit tests that simulate clock skew +/- 2s to ensure min_wait prevents immediate retry.
ben: I'll open SDK PRs across ruby/go/python/java with parser + tests + feature flag. Will include sample-apps PR to attach idempotency header and update signing helper to include header in signature.
zoe: I'll add the CI lint and sample e2e job; mercy please add the devex onboarding note about header semantics and signing guidance.
mercy: Will do. Also will add a short code snippet for receivers showing how to dedupe by X-Redwood-Idempotency + HMAC verification.
akira: Acceptance criteria for merge: unit tests for all date formats, integration e2e asserting wait > 0 for date-based RA, sample-apps attach idempotency header by default, CI lint in place, telemetry metric created with initial dashboard.
ben: ETA: PRs in today, e2e and lint in CI tomorrow, staging validation after lunch. Will tag reviewers.
zoe: Thanks team :thumbsup: Keep updates here if anything unexpected crops up.
